notes.title: Notes
notes.stats: The debuff reduces HP, STR, VIT, MAG, SPR, SPD, LUCK, EVA, and all elemental and status attack and defense values; Hit% is unaffected. Most stats are reduced directly from their respective caps, while HP is reduced before the 9,999 HP cap is applied. Although it requires more investment, reaching 9,999 HP is still possible, allowing a well-built character to survive fixed-damage attacks such as Omega Weapon’s Megido Flame, which deals 9,998 damage.
notes.aura: The practical effect is simple: reducing or even eliminating Limit Break spam by characters at maximum HP.
notes.meltdown: The Meltdown effect caused by both the spell and the GF Doomtrain will no longer reduce VIT and SPR to zero and will instead reduce them by 20% and 70%, respectively. This new effect will reduce the disproportionate difference between physical and magical attacks while at the same time increasing the game’s difficulty and requiring the player to develop and explore multiple battle strategies.
notes.weaponization: All bosses in Ultimecia's Castle have been rebalanced: they are now level 100, have had their HP multiplied, and have received major improvements to Strength, Magic, defenses, and Speed. Only old Omega has no other changes beyond the level 100 adjustment. A dedicated build, a good battle strategy, and thorough exploration of mechanics and vulnerabilities will be necessary if you want to achieve victory by relying more on control than luck. Outside the Castle, the increase in the energy field at the Deep Sea Research Center has also strengthened Bahamut and Ultima Weapon, which will give you a taste of what lies ahead in the Castle. These bosses will definitely test your ability to adapt and read the game.
notes.magic_regen: Now, your spells will not be counted as a unitary and directly finite value, but as a “mana bar” that goes from 0% to 100%. As long as you do not zero out the mana of an acquired spell, it will recover passively through your spirit as you progress through the game. If you completely zero out a spell’s mana, you will need to reacquire it again. You will still be able to discard any spell from your inventory when it is no longer needed.
notes.draws: Despite being stronger and rebalanced, Limit Breaks have become harder to access. As a result, exploiting enemy weaknesses and using magic more frequently will become unavoidable. To reduce the punitive feeling of using magic, this effect, alongside Magic Regen, aims to make replenishing spells much easier. All Draw Points now grant 10 to 15 magic units, while each Draw Command in battle extracts 6 to 12 units of any spell.

normal.name: Normal
normal.tooltip: The original FINAL FANTASY VIII Remastered experience. Enemy levels follow the party average, and all systems remain available. Recommended for a first playthrough, achievements, and the original game balance.
normal.mechanics: The standard difficulty level of FINAL FANTASY VIII Remastered.
normal.progression: Enemy levels scale according to your party’s level. All boosts from the Remastered version can be enabled or disabled throughout gameplay.
normal.tagline: Ideal for your first run, earning achievements, and experiencing the game as originally intended.

junction_breakdown.name: Junction Breakdown
junction_breakdown.tooltip: Could this be the new normal? Junction Breakdown is the first spell to transcend time, marking the beginning of a great change in the world as you know it. In addition to weakening both you and your Guardian Forces, it strengthens your enemies as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw near. Combining low-level play with extreme Junction farming is no longer the dominant solution: leveling up becomes the intended path forward.
junction_breakdown.mechanics: Final character stats are reduced by 15%, except Hit%.
junction_breakdown.progression: Enemy levels no longer scale with the party’s average level. Instead, they rise with story progression as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw nearer, following the fixed ranges below:
junction_breakdown.curve: Disc 1: Lv. 9→30 · Disc 2: Lv. 30→60 · Disc 3: Lv. 60→100 · Disc 4: Lv. 100
junction_breakdown.aura_effect: Aura's effect is reduced by 30% · Meltdown Effect is reduced.
junction_breakdown.level_progression: Enemy levels are fixed according to story progression as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw nearer, following the ranges below:
junction_breakdown.level_curve: Disc 1: Lv. 9→30 · Disc 2: Lv. 30→60 · Disc 3: Lv. 60→100 · Disc 4: Lv. 100
junction_breakdown.tagline: How strong can you be when things are no longer the same?

no_mercy.name: No Mercy
no_mercy.tooltip: No Mercy, the second phase, amplifies Junction Breakdown's power and breaks paradigms by eliminating Card Mod as an easy route to rare items. Players must level up, explore other item sources, and develop new strategies to obtain stronger weapons and overcome the campaign.
no_mercy.mechanics: Final character stats are reduced by 20%, except Hit%.
no_mercy.progression: Enemy levels no longer scale with the party’s average level. Instead, they rise with story progression as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw nearer, following the fixed ranges below:
no_mercy.curve: Disc 1: Lv. 10→32 · Disc 2: Lv. 32→65 · Disc 3: Lv. 65→100 · Disc 4: Lv. 100
no_mercy.features: Card Mod and Battle Assistance are blocked.
no_mercy.aura_effect: Aura's effect is reduced by 40% · Meltdown Effect is reduced.
no_mercy.level_progression: Enemy levels are fixed according to story progression as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw nearer, following the ranges below:
no_mercy.level_curve: Disc 1: Lv. 10→32 · Disc 2: Lv. 32→65 · Disc 3: Lv. 65→100 · Disc 4: Lv. 100
no_mercy.tagline: Your cards can’t help you when their magic is gone.

armageddon.name: Armageddon
armageddon.tooltip: Here, Ultimecia will go to any lengths, unleashing her last resort, which could wipe her out of existence if she fails to stop you. Armageddon, the final spell, pushes Junction Breakdown and No Mercy to the extreme, applying a much steeper enemy level curve and far more severe stat reductions. Aura suffers its greatest reduction, making Limit Break spamming far less reliable. More than ever, victory demands carefully planned progression, resource management, tactical builds and decisions, and exploiting weaknesses in every major battle.
armageddon.mechanics: Final character stats are reduced by 25%, except Hit%.
armageddon.progression: Enemy levels no longer scale with the party’s average level. Instead, they rise with story progression as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw nearer, following the fixed ranges below:
armageddon.curve: Disc 1: Lv. 11→35 · Disc 2: Lv. 35→70 · Disc 3: Lv. 70→100 · Disc 4: Lv. 100
armageddon.features: Card Mod, Ribbon, and Battle Assistance are blocked.
armageddon.aura_effect: Aura's effect is reduced by 50% · Meltdown Effect is reduced.
armageddon.level_progression: Enemy levels are fixed according to story progression as the Lunar Cry and Time Compression draw nearer, following the ranges below:
armageddon.level_curve: Disc 1: Lv. 11→35 · Disc 2: Lv. 35→70 · Disc 3: Lv. 70→100 · Disc 4: Lv. 100
armageddon.tagline: To break your limits, you must first be pushed to them.

settings.frame_generation_title:
{Ultra Quality Mode} - Uses the highest internal resolution to preserve more detail.
{High Quality Mode} - Focuses on maintaining maximum graphical quality at the expense of frame rate.
{Quality Mode} - Aims to balance fluidity and graphic quality.
{Performance} - Focuses on frame generation with slightly reduced graphical quality.
{High Performance} - Maximum focus on frame generation with a moderate reduction in graphics.

If the selected target cannot be reached, lower the FPS target or select Performance Mode.
settings.frame_generation_unavailable: Frame generation addon is not installed.
settings.auracrt_title:
[Aura CRT] is a high-end CRT filter developed exclusively to let Final Fantasy VIII fans and retro gamers play the game again like as in the golden age of the PlayStation 1 and CRT TVs and monitors.

Among its main benefits, [Aura CRT] drastically reduces pixelation, image noise, and considerably improves the dithering, lighting, shadowing and transparency effects of pre-rendered backgrounds, whether original or upscaled. It also helps blend character models, NPCs, and 3D objects more naturally with the backgrounds, making the image more cohesive, while smoothing transitions between pixels and frames and improving movement during gameplay.

[Aura CRT] is not just a visual enhancement, it is a rescue of the game’s original mood.

I hope you enjoy it ;)
settings.bilinear_filter_title:
Choose how strongly the [Bilinear Filter] should be applied to smooth the game's pre-rendered backgrounds.
{Disabled} - Loads the background textures without any correction or anti-aliasing.
{Smooth} - Applies a light correction. Recommended if you use {Upscaled Backgrounds} mods.
{Strong} - Applies a heavy correction. Recommended if you use only the {Original Backgrounds}.
settings.crt_black_mask_title: Choose how finely [Aura CRT] resolves its CRT mask and scanline definition. The higher the definition, the more detail is preserved, but the less it smooths out jaggies. I recommend the {Premium TV} preset for most resolutions and displays.
settings.timecompression_title:
["Eden Learned Ultimecia's Time Compression!"]
Now you can manipulate time the way you want by adjusting the Speed Boost feature to practically any value between 1x and 3x. With this feature enabled, you will be able to choose or your {Default Speed} through the {F3} key on the keyboard or {L3} on an Xbox/XInput-compatible controller.
settings.timecompression_show_icon_title: If "OFF", hides the [Custom Speed Boost] display icon without disabling the feature.
settings.timecompression_speed_title: Adjust [Speed Boost] to a {Custom Value} between {1x} and {3x}. It is enabled only when a value is actually set between those two limits. In addition to increasing in-game movement speed, this setting also increases FPS as a side effect. I recommend starting at {1.2x}, which gives the game a {20% increase in speed and FPS} while still preserving a natural and smooth sense of movement.
settings.hide_demaster_title: If 'ON', hides the Demaster window by launching the game.
settings.skip_splash_title: If 'ON', skips the game's initial opening screens and goes straight to the Title Screen.
settings.captions_title: Enables synchronized captions containing the lyrics to {Liberi Fatali} and {Eyes on Me} in the opening and ending videos. The caption language will follow the language selected here in the Launcher.
settings.background_effect_title: Choose a website effect. Random and Infinite Cycle change effects on launch, main tab changes, and Settings or Challenges sidebar actions. Off is excluded.
settings.sound_effects_title: Enable or disable Eden Launcher interface sound effects.
settings.force_widescreen_title: If 'ON', stretches the game to widescreen.
settings.display_title: Choose which monitor to show the game on.
settings.resolution_title: Increase or decrease the resolution based on the selected display.
settings.screen_mode_title: Choose a screen mode for the game window.
settings.aspect_ratio_custom_error: Unable to save Custom Aspect Ratio
settings.aspect_ratio_title:
Choose how the game will be displayed on screen:

[4:3] {Original} - Reduced framing, including the cinematic black bars at the top and bottom of the screen.
[4:3] {No Letterbox} - Removes the horizontal cinematic bars, enlarging the game image without changing its aspect ratio.
[4:3] {No Letterbox (Fill Ambient)} - Keeps the sharp 4:3 image and fills the sides with a smoothed ambient projection.
[16:9] {Widescreen (Smart Stretch):} Stretches only the Field Background scenes and FMVs. Menus and dialog boxes retain their original aspect ratio and are repositioned for the new screen aspect ratio where appropriate. Battles and the World Map gain a genuine increase in visibility.
[16:9] {Widescreen (Smart Crop):} Applies a slight crop to Field Background scenes and FMVs, virtually eliminating the stretching effect. Menus and dialog boxes retain their original aspect ratio and are repositioned for the new screen aspect ratio where appropriate. Battles and the World Map gain a genuine increase in visibility.
settings.fmv_limit_breaker_title: Select the cutscene video rate: 15 (Native), 30, 45 or 60 FPS.
settings.fmv_limit_breaker_unavailable_title: Install and enable the 4K 60 FPS video mod to adjust FMV frame rates.
settings.controller_layout_title:
Choose which controller button symbols the game displays.

• {Auto} - Uses the game's current controller detection
• {Xbox / XInput} - Always displays Xbox button symbols
• {PlayStation / DualShock 4} - Always displays PlayStation button symbols
settings.analog_movement_title: Restores the PSX version's full {360° Analog Movement}, removing the eight-direction limitation from the PC ports, including the Remastered version.
settings.vibration_mode_title:
Select your preferred [Vibration Mode]. You can also change the selected mode during gameplay using {LT+Select}.

{Off} - The standard vibration setting across all PC and console releases of Final Fantasy VIII Remastered.

{PSX Forever} - Restores the original vibration effects from the PSX version.

{Ultra Waves} - Sound is vibration! In addition to restoring the PSX effects, Ultra Waves translates field and battle sound effects into controller vibration. Just Try It!
settings.ultrawaves_intensity_title: Customize [Ultra Waves] mode by increasing, reducing, or even removing vibration effects using the controls below.
settings.vibration_restore_defaults_title: Activates vibration effects and applies a responsive and balanced configuration.
settings.world_effects_title: Adds vibration to world-map sounds, including cars, the Garden, Ragnarok, and other vehicles.
settings.field_effects_title: Adds vibration to field sounds, including doors, elevators, machinery, and moving objects.
settings.shake_effects_title: Beyond sound, adds vibration to screen shake and sudden camera movement during vehicle rides, train journeys, and chases.
settings.battle_effects_title: Adds vibration to attacks, spells, draw, impacts, and other battle sound effects.
settings.step_effects_title: Adds vibration to party and character footsteps in fields and on the world map.
settings.advanced_controls_title:
If "ON", allows you to change some [Advanced Settings] during gameplay using the {Keyboard} or an {Xbox/XInput controller}.

[Custom Speed Boost]
{F4} or {LT+A} - Reduces Custom Speed Boost by 0.05x
{F5} or {LT+X} - Increases Custom Speed Boost by 0.05x

[Frame Generation]
{F6} or {LT+Y} - Cycles the FPS target for the current scene: Battle 15/30/45/60/75/90/120 FPS; Field / WorldMap 30/60/90/120 FPS

[360° Movement]
{F7} or {LT+B} - Enables or disables 360° Movement

[Aura CRT]
{F8} or {LT+RB} - Changes the Aura CRT presets

[Bilinear Filter]
{F10} or {LT+LB} - Cycles Bilinear Filter

[Skip Cutscene]
{End} or {LT+Start} - Skips the Active FMV.
settings.battle_assist_title: If "OFF", disables this feature’s in-game commands.
settings.no_encounters_title: If "OFF", disables this feature’s in-game commands.
settings.speed_boost_title: If "OFF", disables this feature’s in-game commands.
settings.restore_defaults_title: Restores the settings by applying a balanced setup focused on gameplay.
settings.general_restore_defaults_title: Restores the default values for the controls on the General tab.
settings.graphics_restore_defaults_title: Restores the recommended visual settings on the Graphics tab.
settings.performance_restore_defaults_title: Restores the default values designed to increase movement speed and fluidity without compromising natural motion or smoothness. On compatible hardware, it also applies a balanced interpolated frame-generation profile for greater fluidity while preserving the game's visual integrity.
settings.ultimate_defaults_title: Applies my recommended configuration so you can focus on the story and gameplay, while maintaining a good balance between challenge, quality of life, visuals, and overall game experience.

triple_triad.global_rules_title: No more hidden RNG tricks. With [Triple Triad Global Rules], you can {keep}, {spread}, or {abolish} any Triple Triad rule with complete control and transparency. When disabled, the game uses its original regional rules.
triple_triad.rule_state_title:
[Keep] - Keeps it as a regional rule.
[Spread] - Applies it globally.
[Abolish] - Removes it globally.
triple_triad.trade_rule_state_title:
[Keep] - Keeps it as a regional rule.
[Spread] - Applies it globally.
[Abolish] - Removes it globally.

{Note:} Only one of the four Trade Rules can be active in each region. Spreading one of them globally automatically abolishes the other three. If you abolish all four Trade Rules, no cards are exchanged after the match, regardless of whether you win or lose.
triple_triad.open_title: Reveals the opponent’s five-card hand throughout the match.
triple_triad.same_title: When the card played matches the touching values of at least two adjacent cards, with at least one controlled by the opponent, the matching opponent cards are captured. Captured cards can then trigger a Combo.
triple_triad.plus_title: When the sums of the touching values are equal on at least two sides, the corresponding opponent cards are captured. Captured cards can then trigger a Combo.
triple_triad.random_title: Randomly selects your five-card hand from the cards in your collection instead of allowing you to choose it.
triple_triad.sudden_death_title: If the match ends in a draw, an immediate rematch begins. Each player receives the cards they controlled at the end of the previous match.
triple_triad.same_wall_title: Treats each edge of the board as an A value when checking Same, allowing a wall to count as one of the required matches. This rule only works while Same is active.
triple_triad.elemental_title: Adds elemental spaces to the board. A card placed on a matching element gains +1 to all four values, while any other card placed there loses 1. Same, Plus, and Same Wall still use the card’s original values.
triple_triad.none_title: No cards are exchanged after the match.
triple_triad.one_title: The winner chooses one card from the loser.
triple_triad.diff_title: The winner chooses a number of cards equal to the final score difference.
triple_triad.direct_title: Each player receives every card showing their color at the end of the match, regardless of who originally owned it.
triple_triad.all_title: The winner takes all five cards used by the loser.
triple_triad.restore_defaults_title: Enables Global Rules and applies the recommended settings for a more balanced game.
triple_triad.special_rule_required: At least one Special Rule must remain Keep or Spread. All Special Rules cannot be abolished.
